verdict.rationale: The Insights Agent gives recommendations and conversational insights built on Incidents, Services, and Teams analytics, which implies an analytics layer exists. On-Call Readiness Reports give a team-filtered view of each responder's readiness, though only in terms of notification-rule configuration. MTTR shows up only as a goal of AI orchestrations, not as a reported metric. Missing for 10: explicit MTTA/MTTR trend reporting, incident-load dashboards, on-call health metrics beyond notification readiness (e.g. burden or after-hours load), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
